exposure: site of first admission in labor
cohort: A subsample of medically low-risk childbearing people qualified for birth center admission in labor, derived from the American Association of Birth Centers Perinatal Data Registry.
finding: Overall clinical outcomes in the study sample exceeded national benchmarks across all places of admission, despite disparities like higher cesarean birth rates among Black and Hispanic people.
mod_finding: Higher cesarean birth rates were observed among Black and Hispanic people, especially those who preferred hospital admission in labor without medical indication.
